name: AgentMall 路演环境
postStartCommand: bash -c 'setsid nohup python3 -m uvicorn agentmall.web.app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 >/tmp/am_web.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & setsid nohup python3 scripts/run_mcp_public.py >/tmp/am_mcp.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & setsid nohup python3 -m uvicorn agentmall.web.admin_app:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8002 >/tmp/am_admin.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & sleep 8; curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8001/healthz && curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8002/healthz && echo ALL_UP'
